knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with permission to search `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure: Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`, Splunkbase 3088).
• Ensure `google:gcp:audit` events are flowing (prerequisite UC: none when applicable).
• Map `gcp` and field extractions per `docs/guides/aws.md`, `docs/guides/azure.md`, or `docs/guides/gcp.md` as appropriate.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Create Pub/Sub sink for audit logs; configure Splunk GCP add-on subscription input.
Expected sourcetype: `google:gcp:audit`. Validate with:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit"
| table _time protoPayload.methodName resource.labels.project_id
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
The search scopes `google:gcp:audit` in `index=gcp` and applies `*` to surface `GCP Cloud Audit Log Baseline Ingestion and Health`. Tune time range and alert threshold to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare result counts to the vendor console (CloudTrail Event history, Azure Activity Log, GCP Logs Explorer, or service-native UI). Spot-check `_time` and actor fields. Confirm CIM acceleration only after TA field mappings are verified.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_3_41_alert` with appropriate severity. Dashboard: Single value events 24h, project coverage, ingestion lag..
Failure modes: (1) empty results — verify TA input and index routing; (2) duplicate events — check S3/SQS duplication; (3) missing fields — upgrade `Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`, Splunkbase 3088)` and review `props.conf` aliases; (4) alert fatigue — add CMDB/allow-list exclusions documented in knownFalsePositives.
